name: Publish Bulk CDK Base

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'airbyte-cdk/bulk/core/base/**'

jobs:
  publish-base:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      MAVEN_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_USERNAME }}
      MAVEN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_PASSWORD }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '17'

      - name: Detect changed files
        id: filter
        uses: dorny/paths-filter@v3
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          base: ${{ github.ref }}
          filters: |
            base:
              - 'airbyte-cdk/bulk/core/base/**'

      - name: Check base version
        if: steps.filter.outputs.base == 'true'
        uses: gradle/gradle-build-action@v3
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.7'
          build-root-directory: 'airbyte-cdk/bulk'
          arguments: ':core:base:checkBaseVersion'
        env:
          MAVEN_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_USERNAME }}
          MAVEN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Build base
        if: steps.filter.outputs.base == 'true'
        uses: gradle/gradle-build-action@v3
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.7'
          build-root-directory: 'airbyte-cdk/bulk'
          arguments: ':core:base:build'
        env:
          MAVEN_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_USERNAME }}
          MAVEN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Publish base
        if: steps.filter.outputs.base == 'true'
        uses: gradle/gradle-build-action@v3
        with:
          gradle-version: '8.7'
          build-root-directory: 'airbyte-cdk/bulk'
          arguments: ':core:base:publish'
        env:
          MAVEN_USERNAME: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_USERNAME }}
          MAVEN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.MAVEN_PASSWORD }}
